From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro and SME confirmation

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: lower inference cost per 1M tokens, improve tail latency for your multi-tenant predictor, and establish a data handling path that meets your security team’s controls.
- Constraints: existing infra is GCP us-west2, procurement prefers a single PO + SOC2 evidence, and you want a 30-min technical intro before legal/finance loop.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-minute product intro (high-level demo + ops prep) — I’m proposing two firm options + one backup so stakeholders can pick:
   - Option A: Thu Nov 5, 10:00–10:30 PT
   - Option B: Fri Nov 6, 14:00–14:30 PT
   - Backup: Mon Nov 9, 09:00–09:30 PT
2) Can you confirm who from Aurelia should be on the call (ops/SRE + security)? We’ll include our SRE lead and solutions engineer.
3) I attached a one-pager and my notes from today — please skim the mutual action plan draft; we’ll iterate after the demo.

Attachments: redwood-brief-1pager.pdf (overview), aurelia-discovery-notes.txt (call notes), mutual-action-plan-draft.docx

If any of these slots work, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short prep doc (1–2 bullet items) for your SME.

Thanks —
Ben

Perfect — locking Friday Nov 6, 14:00–14:30 PT. Calendar invite sent (see link above).

Prep bullets for Rajiv and Aurelia SRE:
- Brief topology we’ll demo: Redwood-hosted API -> optional Dedicated pool (GPU) -> prefix/KV cache example with a short sequence replay showing cache hit vs cold run.
- Quantization and batching tradeoffs: how we reduced token CPU/GPU time in recent deployments (2–4x cost delta example).
- What we need from you in the pre-call: a short example request pattern (typical prompt length, concurrent requests) and any must-have compliance controls to validate.

Marissa — looping you and Rishi as ops/SE coverage. Rishi, could you be on the call to answer kernel/quantization questions?

I’ve attached the one-pager and the discovery notes; I’ll follow up with the SOC2 pointer and a short Mutual Action Plan link for signatures if you want to accelerate procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to Friday.
Ben
